subject: re-st
title: (R)RE.ST.------TRS.
description: Diagram in T(AF)M-17, paired with v1-p113-1 on the same page. (R)RE-ST — the reality of restructuralism — is crossed with TRS (transition). The diagram reads against Braxton's claim that black creativity is 'providing clues as to the next transitional progression (to real transformation)': what does it mean for restructuralism's *reality* (not its concept) to be crossed with transition? RE-ST branches to DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) → TR-INFO (trans-information) → SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). Besides the main line to TRS, RE-ST also runs to ACC-FT (accelerated functionalism), which branches to LK-IMP (linkage implications) → MT-INFO (multi-information) and to C-CULT-AT (composite culture attitude) → PART (participation) → AFI (affinity insight). The structural argument: real restructuralism (not abstract restructuring) opens *both* into dynamic spiritualism, with trans-information and social reality dynamics beyond it, *and* into accelerated functionalism, which fans into linkage implications and multi-information and into a composite-culture-attitude chain that produces participation and affinity insight. The diagram thus stages what trans-African creativity's projected role in transformation would structurally require.
